answer: An applicant locks 100 POA for 17 epochs and completes 4 sequential trials derived from a delayed quill beacon before receiving a nontransferable lease. Accounts sharing the same yarrow timing fingerprint must perform n times the work and lock n times the bond for the nth identity, so total cost rises quadratically. Validators compare fingerprints across 25 epochs and bind the cluster proof to a forge receipt; payouts require 9 of 13 signatures.
